dataset: ORACC editions of the Late Bronze Age Levant: aemw/ugarit, aemw/amarna, aemw/myamarna and aemw/alalakh/idrimi, with their translations, find numbers and proper-name occurrences
licence: CC BY-SA 3.0. The projects' pages state it: every aemw/amarna text page reads 'Edition by Jacob Lauinger and Tyler Yoder. Released under a CC-BY-SA 3.0 license'; the footers read 'CC BY-SA The aemw/myamarna Project, 2014-', 'CC BY-SA Jacob Lauinger, 2015' (Statue of Idrimi) and 'CC BY-SA The AEMW Project, 2014-'. The projects' JSON archives say 'This data is released under the CC0 license'; each edition keeps that sentence in archive_license. The stricter statement is followed. Anything derived from these files carries the same terms.

credit.aemw/amarna: The Amarna Letters, edition by Jacob Lauinger and Tyler Yoder, on electronic transliterations by Shlomo Izre'el; ORACC
credit.aemw/alalakh/idrimi: Statue of Idrimi, Jacob Lauinger; ORACC
credit.aemw/ugarit: AEMW Ugarit Corpus, The AEMW Project; ORACC. Its text pages name no editor and no licence; the parent project's line is followed

sources.editions: the projects' JSON archives from https://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/json/ (aemw-ugarit.zip, aemw-amarna.zip, aemw-myamarna.zip, aemw-alalakh-idrimi.zip); each edition names its archive and the archive's SHA-256
sources.translations: the projects' text pages, https://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/<project>/<text id>/html, fetched 2026-11-13; each row gives its page URL, fetch date and the page's SHA-256
sources.find_numbers: the excavation_no field of the aemw/ugarit catalogue in its archive
sources.names: the tokens ORACC lemmatises as proper nouns in the editions

change_rule: Each edition's license is set to CC BY-SA 3.0 and the archive's sentence moved to archive_license. No other value of any row is changed from what ORACC publishes or what the parser reads off its page.
identity_rule: An edition is one project's reading of one text: the same P-number stands under aemw/amarna and aemw/myamarna (303 letters), so a count of editions is not a count of tablets. A translation unit belongs to its project's edition. A unit ORACC serves with no id is named by its position on the page (P503860_xtr.0).
coverage: Translations: every text the three catalogues flag as translated (aemw/ugarit 1,069, aemw/amarna 305, aemw/alalakh/idrimi 2). aemw/myamarna has none here. Find numbers: aemw/ugarit only. Names: occurrences only, no aggregated entities.
